vision.name: Vegeta
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage of damage. While the top and bottom cards of your discard pile are Styled, effects cannot end combat nor cause a player to skip or pass an action.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack.
Banish 2 cards from either player's discard pile. You may raise a player's anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 6 stages.
